Precisely revise this illustration, preserving its excellent truck drawing, camera angle, cab, wheel layout and clean 2D painted style. Make the following corrections, ALL mandatory:
1 REMOVE THE ENTIRE GHOSTED CITY BACKGROUND and all buildings/trees/other trucks. Replace with plain continuous very pale neutral-gray loading yard. No sky horizon, no vignette fading through the truck, no collage. The truck itself remains fully opaque, sharp and complete, including top edge of its trailer.
2 The semitrailer is too tall. Lower its TOP EDGE to exactly the cab roof height while keeping the floor and wheels unchanged. Fully visible complete far wall and front bulkhead. Its interior has NO VERTICAL PARTITIONS: remove the two tall dividers through the cargo bay. One continuous open cargo volume. Roof and near side wall omitted as a clean deliberate cutaway. A narrow opaque near-side sill indicates sectioned wall. Rear at LEFT is OPEN: show the two hinged rear doors folded outward, not a closed door panel blocking the rear.
3 SHRINK THE ORANGE CAMERA CARTON to HALF its current width and height. It must be substantially smaller than a truck wheel. Shrink the tableware carton beneath it by about one third, keep both resting on the floor/support. The small camera gift stays secured with red straps on top of the tableware. Lots of visibly EMPTY SPACE above this small camera up to roof line. Keep wineglass pictogram on tableware.
4 Middle-right narrow niche should be visible behind EXACTLY THREE small ordinary closed cartons in the foreground (currently only two clear ones). The tall space at the front bulkhead, nearest the cab, remains visibly EMPTY down to its floor, with two horizontal red restraints. Move both boxed pillow shipments beside this space, not occupying it. Pillows remain in closed cartons with pillow pictograms. Heavy crates with weight symbols remain over rear trailer axle group.
5 LIGHTEN ALL OUTLINES to medium or light neutral gray. Especially wheels, chassis, cargo and cab. No black/brown bold stroke. Preserve precision through painted color separation and fine quiet details. LIGHTEN the ground shadow to pale neutral gray and SOFTEN ITS EDGES into a wide subtle penumbra. The shadow must NOT be a sharply outlined solid gray shape. Soften the interior wall shadows too. Keep light-blue window glass and warm clean colors. Do not blur the whole artwork; only cast shadow edges are soft.
6 Maintain plausible consistent scale. A long semitrailer, tractor cab of matching height, ordinary small shipping cartons, one much smaller camera gift. No extra gift, no forklift, no people, no text or numbers. Do not change the artistic direction. Only the listed corrections, finish as a clean polished game illustration.
